name: Ledger Wallet
install: npm install --prefix ../pnpm --no-save --no-audit --no-fund pnpm@10.24.0 && PATH="$(cd ../pnpm/node_modules/.bin && pwd):$PATH" pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --filter "ledger-live-desktop..." --filter "." && node tools/nx/write-nx-cache-config.mjs && node {recipe}/tsc-wrapper.config.mjs "$PWD"

build.command: export PATH="$(cd ../pnpm/node_modules/.bin && pwd):$PATH" && NX_DAEMON=false NX_NO_CLOUD=true NX_SKIP_REMOTE_CACHE=true pnpm nx run ledger-live-desktop:build-lib-deps --parallel=1 && cd apps/ledger-live-desktop && rm -rf dist-orivon && node -e "require('./tools/utils/processReleaseNotes')()" && NODE_ENV=production LEDGER_WALLET_CLONE="$(cd ../.. && pwd)" pnpm exec rspack build --config {recipe}/rspack.orivon.config.cjs
